title: FlashReFocus: Interactive Image Refocusing in Seconds
title_zh: FlashReFocus：数秒内实现交互式图像重新对焦

paragraphs.en: 单次扩散模型配合轻量渲染网络，FlashReFocus实现秒级交互式照片重新对焦，编辑速度提升数百倍。 Single-image refocusing changes the focal plane and depth of field of a photograph after capture. It is inherently interactive: users try many focal points and blur strengths on one image, so each edit should be fast and change only the blur. Recent generative methods, however, rerun large diffusion models for every edit. We observe that the two sub-problems differ in kind: recovering the all-in-focus image is ill-posed and needs a generative prior, whereas rendering blur is largely determined by depth and the focal plane. We therefore propose FlashReFocus, which runs diffusion once per photograph and renders every edit with a lightweight network. To address the ill-posed restoration, a one-step diffusion deblurrer with a decoder refiner recovers fine detail efficiently while balancing fidelity and perceptual quality. For precise control, the renderer is conditioned on an explicit defocus map and uses defocus-bias attention, which lets pixels at similar defocus share information without interference from pixels at other depths; in-focus content stays unchanged, and editing the map yields tilt-shift and two focal planes. To further test generalization to unseen cameras, we collect 3CReal, a three-camera benchmark of 89 pairs. FlashReFocus achieves the best perceptual fidelity for zero-shot bokeh rendering on EBB! and 3CReal, refocuses 148.3x faster than GenRefocus, and takes about half a second per further edit, 462x faster.
paragraphs.zh: 单张图像重新对焦是指在拍摄后改变照片的焦平面和景深。单次扩散模型配合轻量渲染网络，FlashReFocus实现秒级交互式照片重新对焦，编辑速度提升数百倍。 这项任务天然具有交互性：用户会在同一张图像上尝试多个焦点和模糊强度，因此每次编辑都应该快速，并且只改变模糊效果。 然而，近期的生成式方法在每次编辑时都要重新运行大型扩散模型。 我们观察到两个子问题在性质上不同：恢复全清晰图像是病态问题，需要生成先验，而渲染模糊在很大程度上由深度和焦平面决定。 因此，我们提出FlashReFocus，它对每张照片只运行一次扩散模型，并用轻量网络渲染每次编辑。 为解决病态的复原问题，一个带解码器精炼模块的单步扩散去模糊器能够高效恢复精细细节，同时平衡保真度与感知质量。 为实现精确控制，渲染器以显式散焦图为条件，并采用散焦偏置注意力，使散焦程度相近的像素可以共享信息而不受其他深度像素的干扰；清晰区域保持不变，编辑该散焦图还可以实现移轴效果和双焦平面。 为进一步测试对未见过的相机的泛化能力，我们收集了3CReal，一个包含89对图像的三相机基准数据集。 FlashReFocus在EBB!和3CReal上实现了零样本背景虚化渲染的最佳感知保真度，重新对焦速度比GenReFocus快148.3倍，每次后续编辑约需半秒钟，快462倍。
